name: collection_stack_refolds
description: Stacking onto a remainder row re-runs the identity fold (docs/loot.md §34, AGENTS.md §52.19): a capped fold leaves curated STEEL_SHIELD (cap 2) 2 + loot twin id 193 x2; removing one curated copy and adding another twin stacks the loot row to 3, and deck_collection_add must re-merge the pair back to curated 2 + remainder 2 instead of leaving curated 1 + loot 3 unmerged. Pre-fix the existing-row path returned before deck_collection_merge_duplicates ran.
